svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 1028 commits across five public projects, 71 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-07 through 2026-10-29 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-10-29T02:56:41.458Z.
